title: The future: tomorrow & je vais
summary: Two ways to talk about the future. (1) Present tense plus a time word: Je le fais demain. Nous les vendons lundi. (2) aller + verb, like 'going to': Nous allons lui demander. Je vais l'acheter. Tu vas les acheter ? aller is irregular: je vais, tu vas, nous allons.
points: Present + time word = future: Je le fais ce soir / demain.
demain = tomorrow. lundi = Monday, and also 'on Monday' (no word for 'on').
acheter: j'achète, ils achètent, nous achetons (weak middle e).
aller + infinitive = going to: Nous allons lui demander. Je vais l'acheter.
aller: je vais, tu vas, nous allons (je vais / tu vas come from a different old verb).
lui / leur = to / for him, her, them: Je vais lui acheter quelque chose.
quelque chose de bien / de gentil = something nice.
les lunettes = glasses (from la lune, moon). les lunettes de soleil = sunglasses.
drills: We'll sell them the car tomorrow.
Nous leur vendons la voiture demain.
They'll sell us the car on Monday.
Ils nous vendent la voiture lundi.
We're buying the glasses on Monday.
I'm going to buy him something.
Je vais lui acheter quelque chose.
Are you going to buy it?
Are you going to buy them?
Are you going to buy them something?
Tu vas leur acheter quelque chose ?
I'm going to buy him something nice.
Je vais lui acheter quelque chose de gentil.
Are you going to buy her something nice?
Vas-tu lui acheter quelque chose de gentil ?
